user_message: Prepare a cash-quality and liquidity note. USD million throughout. Normalize operating FCF by removing factoring cash that is included in reported CFO, then deduct capex. The reserve is a required residual after paying debt. Do not add period FCF to the closing cash balance, and do not treat restricted cash as available. All company names, observations and packet sources are synthetic. Return the declared typed fields and cite the supporting packet source IDs for each field.

sources.text: Synthetic packet. The management cash memorandum provisionally states that all listed factoring receipts are inside reported CFO. Closing cash is the balance after all historical cash-flow movements.

Synthetic packet. The treasury policy ring-fences restricted balances and requires the minimum remaining cash after the supplied debt maturity. Operating normalization and balance-sheet funding are separate analyses.
